trap.see: The tile lying on the clock is frozen and must be thawed first; one of the neighbours that can melt it is locked (it needs the keys): do not melt with the free neighbour whose twin is buried: it would wait in the tray.
fairWhy: the loss shows only after 7+ more removals (> 6)
trap.uiNote: obKind() shows one overlay per tile (ice, else lock, else key): a tile that is both frozen and a key (or locked) would hide the key (or lock) badge, so it is never built; the chain freezes the key COVER, a way tile or a thaw-neighbour instead.

dennis.note: Amazing puzzle again. All of these are great. Just the part after is a tiny bit too easy. Also If I click a frozen tile I want the showing the tiles that thaw it to also light on tiles that arent free to take yet.
